stories.title: Forget 'trusting the process' -- it's a new era in...
stories.summary: Insiders question the move, but a source close to LeBron James put it simply: "I think he just realized he had a lot of meaningful basketball left in him."

stories.title: Sources: Bieniemy's wife shot at couple's home
stories.summary: The wife of Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy was shot by the couple's son Sunday night at the family's home in Virginia.

stories.title: UNC places top Belichick aide Lombardi on leave
stories.summary: North Carolina football GM Michael Lombardi, a top aide to coach Bill Belichick, has been placed on paid administrative leave by the university.

stories.title: Manuel gets $7.14M, other perks in U-M buyout
stories.summary: Departing Michigan athletic director Warde Manuel will receive a $7 million lump sum payment as part of his separation deal, according to a document obtained Monday by The Associated Press.

stories.title: Commanders fire TE coach following DWI charge
stories.summary: The Commanders fired tight ends coach Ben Steele, two days before training camp begins, and more than a month after he was arrested for driving while intoxicated.
